  (simp: crunch_simps wp: crunch_wps)<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma is_transferable_is_arch_update:
  "is_arch_update cap cap' \<Longrightarrow> is_transferable (Some cap) = is_transferable (Some cap')"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. is_arch_update cap cap' \<Longrightarrow> is_transferable_cap cap = is_transferable_cap cap'<\STATESEP>using is_transferable.simps is_arch_cap_def is_arch_update_def cap_master_cap_def<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
using this:
is_transferable ?opt_cap = (?opt_cap = None \<or> ?opt_cap = Some NullCap \<or> (\<exists>t R. ?opt_cap = Some (ReplyCap t False R)))
is_arch_cap ?cap \<equiv> case ?cap of ArchObjectCap x \<Rightarrow> True | _ \<Rightarrow> False
is_arch_update ?cap ?cap' \<equiv> is_arch_cap ?cap \<and> cap_master_cap ?cap = cap_master_cap ?cap'
cap_master_cap ?cap \<equiv> case ?cap of UntypedCap dev ref n f \<Rightarrow> UntypedCap dev ref n 0 | EndpointCap ref bdg rghts \<Rightarrow> EndpointCap ref 0 UNIV | NotificationCap ref bdg rghts \<Rightarrow> NotificationCap ref 0 UNIV | ReplyCap ref master rghts \<Rightarrow> ReplyCap ref True UNIV | CNodeCap ref bits gd \<Rightarrow> CNodeCap ref bits [] | ThreadCap ref \<Rightarrow> ThreadCap ref | DomainCap \<Rightarrow> DomainCap | ArchObjectCap acap \<Rightarrow> ArchObjectCap (case acap of ASIDPoolCap pool asid \<Rightarrow> ASIDPoolCap pool 0 | ASIDControlCap \<Rightarrow> acap | PageCap dev ref rghts sz mapdata \<Rightarrow> PageCap dev ref UNIV sz None | PageTableCap ptr data \<Rightarrow> PageTableCap ptr None | PageDirectoryCap ptr data \<Rightarrow> PageDirectoryCap ptr None) | _ \<Rightarrow> ?cap
